home_title: Your Dental Clinic in Your Pocket
home_desc: With TeleDentist, pre-visit triage, X-ray and photo assessment and treatment follow-up in one panel. Dentistry only.
aim_desc: Not to replace the in-person visit, but to speed it up. We collect your complaint in advance, review your X-rays and photos, and you arrive with a ready treatment plan. We make access easier for people in rural areas, with mobility limitations or special care needs.
step1_d: Pick your unit, write your complaint, be at the clinic 15 minutes early.
step2_d: Upload triage survey + photo so the doctor reviews it in advance.
step3_d: Examination and treatment at the clinic, recorded on your tooth map.
step4_d: You will receive a reminder at the control interval set by your doctor.
about_hero_d: Each section opens with an animation as you scroll. Dentistry scope only.
appt_complaint: Your dental complaint (e.g. pain in molar tooth 16)
appt_kvkk: I have read the KVKK notice and consent to the processing of my data.
appt_sent_d: It will appear in the doctor panel. Refresh the page for a new request.
appt_note: Your request is sent to the doctor panel.
login_patient_s: Sign in to access the My Teeth panel.
login_no_account: No account? Create a registration request
login_choose_s: Patient and doctor logins are separate.
reg_s: Leave your details; your account opens once a doctor approves it.
reg_ok: Your request was received. You can sign in after doctor approval.
fer_desc: Use our E-Appointment system to create your treatment appointments easily.
fer_info: Be at the clinic at least 15 minutes before your appointment.
about_s1_d: Delivering dental care services remotely through information and communication technologies.
about_s2_d: Triage, first assessment, consultation, diagnosis and treatment planning, follow-up and control, oral health education, doctor-to-doctor consultation.
about_s3_d: People living in rural areas, patients with mobility limitations and individuals with special care needs.
about_s4_d: Stronger patient-doctor communication, faster clinical decisions, a recommended hybrid model (in-person + remote).
about_s5_d: Patients, on the other hand, do not actively prefer teledental services due to the difficulty of obtaining them, the lack of face-to-face communication, and the fear of not being able to fully explain their complaints.
about_s6_d: Patient confidentiality, data security and lack of legal standards. KVKK consent is mandatory.
about_s7_d: Effect on dental anxiety, home oral hygiene education, plaque index effects, satisfaction in rural areas.
about_s8_d: Teledentistry is a powerful complementary health service that increases accessibility.
